title: 2026 Midterms as Legitimacy-Catalyst Node (S&H/Turchin Refined)
statement: ORIGIN: Owner gut call (journal 2026-09-14): 'This regime will not hand over power willingly. This election will be the catalyst.' EITHER BRANCH IS CONSISTENT WITH THIS ENTRY; the entry fails only if the election is a non-event — accepted, largely uncontested, with structural pressure visibly DISCHARGING.
